# DateTimePicker

DateTimePicker — a date field and a time field read as one moment. Composed from DatePicker and TimePicker, laid out as labeled sections with a shared time-zone caption under the time.

Also asked as: date and time, schedule.

**Import:** `import { DateTimePicker } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DateTimePicker/DateTimePicker.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DateTimePicker/DateTimePicker.stories.jsx` — Overview, Spacing, Validation, InteractionStates, TimeZones, Interactive, Default, WithValue, Compact, Invalid, Valid, ReadOnly, Disabled, HoveredState, KeyboardFocus

**Motion:** enter `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast` · exit `appearance.fast` · change `spatial.default`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use a date time picker when a date and a time are one answer: a session's start, a deadline. For a date with no time, use Date picker alone; for a time with no date, use Time picker alone.

## Motion

DateTimePicker reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Opens as a Popup. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. |
| change | Step to the next or previous | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | A month change slides the grid flat. |

## Best practices

### `onChange` reports the date, the time and the combined moment. {#onchange-reports-the-date-the-time-and-the-combined-moment}

Each field's change calls `onChange` with `{ date, time, utc }`. `date` and `time` are the two fields' own display values, and `utc` is the ISO moment once both halves are set, computed from `timeZone`. Store `utc`; show `date` and `time` back to the person who typed them.

```jsx
<DateTimePicker
    label="Session start"
    dateValue={date}
    timeValue={time}
    onChange={({ date, time, utc }) => {
        setDate(date);
        setTime(time);
        setStartUtc(utc);
    }}
/>
```

### `label` names the whole field, not either input. {#label-names-the-whole-field-not-either-input}

The label's text is read as the group's accessible name, and the date and time inputs are additionally named off the "Date" and "Time" section headings. `isLabelHidden` only hides the label visually.

### A time-zone mismatch adds the other person's time, it does not replace yours. {#a-time-zone-mismatch-adds-the-other-person-s-time-it-does-not-replace-yours}

`otherTimeZone` only changes the caption when it differs from the viewer's own zone, and then it adds the other person's time rather than converting the field. The fields always show the viewer's local time.

### Show the date and the time in one pattern. {#show-the-date-and-the-time-in-one-pattern}

Date first, then time with AM or PM. The field already sets that order; write the moment the same way wherever else it appears, "10/21/2026, 3:30 PM" and not "2026-10-21 15:30", so people do not have to reread it.

### Always show AM or PM. {#always-show-am-or-pm}

A time without AM or PM can mean two times a day apart. Every time in the time field's list carries its period, so the field always shows it; keep it in any message that repeats the time.

### Name the time zone when it can differ. {#name-the-time-zone-when-it-can-differ}

Tutors and students can sit in different zones. Name the zone next to the time so a session is not missed. `showTimeZone` is on by default.

Do: The zone is named under the time.
Don't: The zone is not named.

### Label the moment by its role. {#label-the-moment-by-its-role}

Do: The label says which moment this is.
Don't: The label names the two halves, not the moment.

### Say what to fix in an error. {#say-what-to-fix-in-an-error}

Do: The message says what to change.
Don't: A bare 'Invalid' does not say what to change.

## Accessibility

- **One group, two named inputs.** The wrapper is `role="group"` named by `label`; the date and time inputs are each named by that label plus their own section heading, so a screen reader announces "Session start, Date" and "Session start, Time".
- **Validation and the time-zone caption are both wired through `aria-describedby`**, composed with anything already passed in rather than overwriting it.
- **`isLabelHidden` never removes the accessible name**, only its visible text.

## Parts

1. **Label.** Names the whole group. `isLabelHidden` hides it visually and keeps the name.
2. **Section labels** (optional). "Date" and "Time" captions above each field.
3. **Date field.** The Date picker, on its own calendar.
4. **Time field.** The Time picker: a list of the day's times, each with its period.
5. **Caption.** One line under the pair: the validation message, or the viewer's time zone and the other person's time.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `--ds-background-input` fill with a `--ds-border-input` border. |
| Hovered | The hovered half's border takes `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the focused half. |
| Invalid | Both borders take `--ds-border-danger`; the caption shows the error message. |
| Valid | Both borders take `--ds-border-success`; the caption shows the success message. |
| Read-only | Both boxes take `--ds-background-neutral`, at full contrast with no hover. The calendar icon and the chevron are not drawn. |
| Disabled | Both boxes fade to `--ds-opacity-disabled` and leave the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill | `--ds-background-input`; read-only `--ds-background-neutral`. |
| Border | `--ds-border-input`; hovered `--ds-border-focused`; invalid `--ds-border-danger`; valid `--ds-border-success`. |
| Caption | `--ds-text-subtle`; error `--ds-text-danger`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Label the moment by its role: "Session start", "Deadline". | A label for each half: "Date and time". |
| Say what to fix: "Choose a start date and time." | "Invalid". |
| Keep the placeholders as formats: MM/DD/YY and __ : __. | Instructions in the placeholders. |
| Name the other person in the time-zone caption: "the student". | A time with no name: "also 1:00 PM". |
